# Kuailu HR | Pricing

| Pricing item | Current evidence in supplied materials |
| --- | --- |
| Official product price | No official Kuailu HR price list is included in the supplied English operations manual, feature list or sales-training deck. |
| Planning assumption | The PMF report proposes Core and country / industry plug-in prices as a v1 commercial hypothesis; these values are not presented as an official price. |
| Commercial confirmation | Confirm edition, employee scope, implementation, integrations, deployment and applicable regional rules in the current quotation or contract. |

### Planning assumptions retained for reference

| Package | PMF v1 assumption | Status |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Core | HK$25 per employee per month, five-employee minimum; SGD$5 per employee per month, five-employee minimum | Internal planning assumption in source report |
| Hong Kong country plug-in | +HK$20 per employee per month | Internal planning assumption in source report |
| Retail or Catering industry plug-in | +HK$15 per employee per month | Internal planning assumption in source report |
| Singapore country plug-in | +SGD$4 per employee per month | Internal planning assumption in source report |
